newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein stable, trade dull.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein stable, trade dull.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were mostly stable in late trading on Tuesday but activity virtually ground to a halt as most players closed early.
They said olein was quoted at 1,435-40 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, unchanged from the opening, but offers were also heard at 1,430 rupiah.
"Most players closed early today because of the Christmas holiday tomorrow," one trader said. "There was very little activity in the market."
Traders said they expected olein prices to remain under pressure through the week, but the downside would be limited.
"The margin between crude palm oil and olein is still thin, so I think this will underpin olein prices," one said.
Traders said the market will be closed on Wednesday for Christmas, adding that trading was expected to be thin through the week due to the holiday season.
